html_title: NebulaMind — AI scientist for galaxy evolution · crew cockpit

baseline.title: THE BASELINE — what “done” means here
baseline.primitive: frontier ranking → frozen measurement contract → reviewed-script measurement → adversarial review → receipted paper
baseline.summary: The goal is publishable science produced end-to-end by the crew: contested frontiers ranked by controversy × tractability, a measurement contract frozen before any science row is fetched, numbers produced only by reviewed scripts, every claim bound to a receipted artifact, and papers that state plainly what they cannot establish. A study reaches the Lab only if it contains something that exists nowhere else — a measurement, a census, or a negative result under a pre-registered contract.

lane_board.detail: Authors scripts and lane artifacts, dispatches the seats, holds no verdict of its own; every number it publishes has passed a reviewer seat.
Prediction entries, contract semantics, plan drafting, and paper prose — forbidden from typing a number that is not read from a receipted artifact.
Adversarial script review before execution, forensic reproduction, plan/amendment gates, per-value stance verification. Escalation seat for reviewer conflicts.
Second reviewer since 2026-08-05: paper-draft referee reads, claim↔artifact binding, overclaim hunting, lane audits. Cross-engine by design.
Consolidated receipt passes — file modes and hashes, artifact custody, totals re-added from raw results, verdicts cross-checked against logs.
Seat retired 2026-08-04 after three integrity failures; re-entered 2026-08-05 on quote-checkable audit work only, every claim verified byte-for-byte by script (first pass: 27/27).

method_board.shared_goal: Measure contested galaxy-evolution frontiers from public data under contracts frozen before the first science row.
